title: Claude CLI Evaluator Configuration
description: Configuration for the Claude CLI Evaluator system that enforces rule adherence at checkpoints

enabled.description: Global enable/disable for the evaluator. When false, all checkpoints are skipped.

model.description: Claude model to use for evaluation. Haiku is faster (~2-3s), Sonnet is more capable.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for Claude CLI calls. System fails open on timeout.

preFlight.description: Pre-flight checkpoint: blocks code writing before implementation workflow is acknowledged

closingCheck.description: Closing check checkpoint: warns on incomplete completion notes when closing items

sessionEnd.description: Session end checkpoint: warns about unsynced beads and uncommitted changes

blocking.description: If true, violations block the action. If false, violations only warn.

timeoutMs.description: Override timeout for this specific checkpoint
